title: Prompt model version sources must be a placeholder or a validated remote URI, never a schemeless local path
answers: register a prompt with a local path as the model version source
model version get-artifact serves files from the server filesystem for a prompt
why does CreateModelVersion reject a relative source for prompt tags
Windows drive letter source accepted for a registered prompt
body:
Symptom: a prompt registered with a schemeless local path (e.g. "mlflow", "etc/passwd", "C:/Windows") is stored as the model version's artifact location, and the model-version get-artifact endpoint then serves files from the server's local filesystem.
Root cause: mlflow/server/handlers.py:_create_model_version prompt branch only rejected file:// and leading-"/" sources and ran the traversal check only when urlparse found a scheme; a Windows drive letter parses as scheme "c" and took the schemed path with no local rejection.
Fix pattern: send every prompt source through mlflow/server/handlers.py:_validate_prompt_source. Classify with mlflow/utils/uri.py:get_uri_scheme; schemed non-file sources get _validate_non_local_source_contains_relative_paths; schemeless sources must exactly equal a value in mlflow/prompt/constants.py:_PROMPT_SOURCE_PLACEHOLDERS, otherwise 400.
Constraints: do not classify with urlparse (single-letter drive scheme). Do not loosen the allowlist to prefix or case-insensitive matching. Which remote schemes a model version may use is a separate question; this rule only closes the local-path route.
applies: Any server-side validation of model version sources when the request is prompt-tagged (mlflow/server/handlers.py).
says: Downloading prompt artifacts exposes local server files when registered with relative paths.
Block users from registering prompt model versions using local filesystem locations.
Prompt artifact downloads should never read or serve internal host operating system files.
Reject prompt creation requests containing Windows drive letters or relative file paths.
search: Prompt model version sources must be validated to strictly require recognized placeholder strings or validated remote URIs, disallowing schemeless local paths. In mlflow/server/handlers.py:_validate_prompt_source, sources are classified using mlflow/utils/uri.py:get_uri_scheme rather than urlparse to prevent Windows drive letters from bypassing local path checks. Schemed non-file sources require _validate_non_local_source_contains_relative_paths, while schemeless sources must match an exact value in mlflow/prompt/constants.py:_PROMPT_SOURCE_PLACEHOLDERS or return status 400.
